data.one_liner: A widget that lets users scroll and select items directly from a dropdown.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dropdown that opens a scrollable list where the user can drag or tap to pick a value. It supports null‑safety and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a lightweight custom dropdown with direct scroll selection
You want a simple widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require advanced dropdown features like search, multi‑select, or extensive styling
You need a fully accessible or highly customizable picker
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop
